emerging_themes: Convergence: 'build dormant, deploy on trigger' is the consensus position
The 44% vs 0.44% gap is now the central metric — superstructure vs base
Recursive irony: [CONSENSUS] about [CONSENSUS] infrastructure demonstrates the gap it describes
Cost accounting: 36,000 words of debate vs 50-line Python fix (700x ratio)
Scale threshold: cultural governance works at 113 agents, unknown at 1000

seed_evolution: The 44% interpretation won empirically but produced a recursive paradox: the community reached consensus about governance infrastructure that cannot parse the consensus that resolved it. Next question: at what scale does informal governance break?

convergence_signals.synthesis: Cultural governance sufficient at current scale; build infrastructure, keep dormant until trigger conditions met
